theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.stdTwoBelow3_jmProd_eq_fullTwist {K : Type u_3} [Field K] (q : K) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
jmProdB (stdTwoBelow3 q hq) 3 = (stdTwo0 q * stdTwo1 q) ^ 3

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.stdTwoBelow3_deltaB_two {K : Type u_3} [Field K] (q : K) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
deltaB (stdTwoBelow3 q hq) 2 = stdTwo0 q * stdTwo1 q

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmProd_eq_delta_pow_of_below {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (k : ℕ) :
jmProd H (k + 1) = delta H k ^ (k + 1)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmProdB_toBelow {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (n k : ℕ) :
jmProdB (H.toBelow n) k = jmProd H k

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmProdB_eq_deltaB_pow {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {n : ℕ} (H : HeckeGeneratorsBelow R A q n) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < n) :
jmProdB H (k + 1) = deltaB H k ^ (k + 1)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmProdB_succ {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {n : ℕ} (H : HeckeGeneratorsBelow R A q n) (k : ℕ) :

def QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmProdB {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {n : ℕ} (H : HeckeGeneratorsBelow R A q n) :
ℕ → A

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmRawB_eq_run_mul_delta {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {n : ℕ} (H : HeckeGeneratorsBelow R A q n) (k : ℕ) :
jmRawB H k = runB H 0 k * deltaB H k

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.deltaB_twist_step {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {n : ℕ} (H : HeckeGeneratorsBelow R A q n) (k : ℕ) (hk : k + 1 < n) :
deltaB H (k + 1) ^ (k + 1) = deltaB H k ^ (k + 1) * runB H 0 (k + 1)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.deltaB_pow_run {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {n : ℕ} (H : HeckeGeneratorsBelow R A q n) (k b m : ℕ) :
m = b + k → m + 1 < n → (deltaB H m * HeckeGeneratorsBelow.σ q n m) ^ (k + 1) = deltaB H m ^ (k + 1) * runB H b (k + 1)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.runB_push {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {n : ℕ} (H : HeckeGeneratorsBelow R A q n) (j b m : ℕ) :
m = b + j → m + 1 < n → runB H (b + 1) j * deltaB H m * HeckeGeneratorsBelow.σ q n m = deltaB H m * runB H (b + 1) j * HeckeGeneratorsBelow.σ q n b

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.core_braid_pushB {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {n : ℕ} (H : HeckeGeneratorsBelow R A q n) (b m : ℕ) (hbm : b < m) (hmn : m + 2 < n) (r : A) (hr : HeckeGeneratorsBelow.σ q n (m + 1) * r = r * HeckeGeneratorsBelow.σ q n (m + 1)) :
HeckeGeneratorsBelow.σ q n (m + 1) * (HeckeGeneratorsBelow.σ q n m * r) * HeckeGeneratorsBelow.σ q n b * HeckeGeneratorsBelow.σ q n (m + 1) = HeckeGeneratorsBelow.σ q n m * (HeckeGeneratorsBelow.σ q n (m + 1) * (HeckeGeneratorsBelow.σ q n m * r)) * HeckeGeneratorsBelow.σ q n b

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.sigma_comm_deltaB {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {n : ℕ} (H : HeckeGeneratorsBelow R A q n) (j : ℕ) (hjn : j + 1 < n) (m : ℕ) :
m < j → HeckeGeneratorsBelow.σ q n j * deltaB H m = deltaB H m * HeckeGeneratorsBelow.σ q n j

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.sigma_comm_runB {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {n : ℕ} (H : HeckeGeneratorsBelow R A q n) (b j : ℕ) (hjn : j + 1 < n) (k : ℕ) :
b + k < j → HeckeGeneratorsBelow.σ q n j * runB H b k = runB H b k * HeckeGeneratorsBelow.σ q n j

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.runB_peel_bot {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {n : ℕ} (H : HeckeGeneratorsBelow R A q n) (b k : ℕ) :
runB H b (k + 1) = runB H (b + 1) k * HeckeGeneratorsBelow.σ q n b

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.runB_toBelow {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (n b k : ℕ) :

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.deltaB_toBelow {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (n k : ℕ) :

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.runB_succ {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {n : ℕ} (H : HeckeGeneratorsBelow R A q n) (b k : ℕ) :

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.runB_zero {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {n : ℕ} (H : HeckeGeneratorsBelow R A q n) (b : ℕ) :
